name: What is the typical cost to install new kitchen lighting in the East Bay area?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical cost to install new kitchen lighting in the East Bay area?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost to install new kitchen lighting in the East Bay area varies widely depending on the scope of work, types of fixtures chosen, and electrical modifications needed. Simple fixture replacements might cost a few hundred dollars, while a complete overhaul with new wiring, recessed lights, and under-cabinet lighting could range from $1,000 to several thousand dollars. It's best to get a detailed quote for your specific project.
acceptedAnswer.description: Cost varies from hundreds for simple replacements to thousands for full overhauls, depending on fixture types and electrical work.
